scope: Analytic exact 1+1 longitudinal spatial diffeomorphism of frozen NL0B bath covector U=q s and NL1C3B/GE05 reduced node action. This is a necessary restricted input to full all-sector H4 Noether, not the mixed H4 source/parent identity and not a Z21 solve.

exact_coframe_and_action.coframe: theta0=N dt, theta1=L(dx+b dt), theta2=R dy, theta3=R dz
exact_coframe_and_action.bath_covector: U_jmu=q_j s_mu, q_j is the orthonormal longitudinal coefficient and not an independently assumed coordinate covector

fixed_spatial_relabeling.scalar_coefficient: delta q=xi*q_x, derived from U=q s and s frame
fixed_spatial_relabeling.metric: delta N=xi*N_x; delta R=xi*R_x; delta L=xi*L_x+L*xi_x
fixed_spatial_relabeling.derivative_transform: delta q_t=xi*q_xt+xi_t*q_x; delta q_x=xi*q_xx+xi_x*q_x; similarly phi

exact_gates: Pin each source file to exact Git blob and verify frozen NL0B and NL1C3B U=q s construction before any algebra.
Prove longitudinal bath covector U_t/U_x transforms as coordinate covector using scalar q and the frozen coframe.
Prove A^t/A^x transforms as coordinate vector and A^mu U_mu vanishes exactly.
Prove Aq=A^mu partial_mu q and Xphi=s(phi) each transform as x-scalar.
Prove NLR^2 and the full reduced GE05 memory node Lagrangian transform as x-density up to a total spatial derivative.
Do not assume generic transverse bath components or a full 3+1 gauge transformation are certified by this scalar-longitudinal proof.
Do not derive or claim the mixed H4 Noether source coefficient, parent residual cancellations or an H4/Z21 solution in this stage.
